# Browser test dependencies

The in-Zotero test page generated by `zotero-plugin-scaffold@0.8.7` loads `mocha.js` and `chai.js`. The scaffold normally fetches Chai from a mutable CDN URL, so `test:init` verifies both files' SHA-256 digests and copies them to `.scaffold/cache/` before bundling the tests.

| File | Version | Source | SHA-256 | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chai.js` | Chai 4.5.0 | `https://registry.npmjs.org/chai/-/chai-4.5.0.tgz` (`package/chai.js`) | `bdc229d660afad0313fc10d6afb5a339956a18c4c6e819d3eb5d8b94f314c202` | MIT; see `chai.LICENSE` |
| `node_modules/mocha/mocha.js` | Mocha 11.7.6 | npm package pinned in `package-lock.json` | `8f46c07ab4422da71bdb27e8f54d0a9ba59b736face2c9f5534c414623c55ef6` | MIT |

The generated page expects Chai's browser global. Chai 6 is ESM-only, so the harness uses Chai 4.
